items.translation: jakarta.jms.JMSException - 如果由 JMS API 方法抛出

items.source:
Subclasses need to implement this method for their specific
invoker management process.
items.translation: 子类需要针对其特定的调用者管理流程实现此方法。

items.source: Delegates to validateConfiguration() and initialize().
items.translation: 委托给validateConfiguration()和initialize()。

items.source: Calls shutdown() when the BeanFactory destroys the container instance.
items.translation: 当 BeanFactory 销毁容器实例时，调用shutdown()。

items.source: Stop the shared Connection, call doShutdown(), and close this container.
items.translation: 停止共享连接，调用doShutdown()，并关闭此容器。

items.source: task - the task object to reschedule
items.translation: task - 要重新安排的任务对象

items.source: This class provides basic lifecycle management, in particular management of a shared JMS Connection. Subclasses are supposed to plug into this lifecycle, implementing the sharedConnectionEnabled() as well as the doInitialize() and doShutdown() template methods.
items.translation: 该类提供基本生命周期管理，特别是对共享 JMS 连接的管理。子类应与此生命周期集成，实现 `sharedConnectionEnabled()` 以及模板方法 `doInitialize()` 和 `doShutdown()`。

items.source: A value of false indicates that the component is intended to be started through an explicit Lifecycle.start() call instead, analogous to a plain Lifecycle implementation.
items.translation: 值为 `false` 表示该组件旨在通过显式的 Lifecycle.start() 调用启动，类似于普通的 Lifecycle 实现。

items.source: Creates a JMS Connection, starts the Connection (if "autoStartup" hasn't been turned off), and calls doInitialize().
items.translation: 创建 JMS 连接，启动 `Connection`（如果未关闭"autoStartup"），并调用doInitialize()。

items.source: This implementation always returns true; the default 'running' state is purely determined by start() / stop().
items.translation: 此实现始终返回 `true`；默认的“运行中”状态完全由start() / stop() 决定。

items.source: For a concrete listener programming model, check out the AbstractMessageListenerContainer subclass. For a concrete listener invoker mechanism, check out the DefaultMessageListenerContainer class.
items.translation: 对于具体的监听器编程模型，请查看 `AbstractMessageListenerContainer` 子类。对于具体的监听器调用机制，请查看 `DefaultMessageListenerContainer` 类。

items.source: Default is "true"; set this to "false" to allow for manual startup through the start() method.
items.translation: 默认为 "true"；将其设置为 "false" 以允许通过 start() 方法手动启动。

items.source: The startup order proceeds from lowest to highest, and the shutdown order is the reverse of that. The default is SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE meaning that this container starts as late as possible and stops as soon as possible.
items.translation: 启动顺序从低到高，而关闭顺序则相反。默认值为 `SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE`，这意味着该容器尽可能晚地启动并尽可能早地停止。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to createSharedConnection(), which does one immediate attempt and throws an exception if it fails. Can be overridden to have a recovery process in place, retrying until a Connection can be successfully established.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 createSharedConnection()，该方法会进行一次立即尝试，如果失败则抛出异常。可以重写它以建立恢复过程，重试直到成功建立连接。

items.source: The default implementation creates a standard Connection and prepares it through prepareSharedConnection(Connection).
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个标准的 Connection，并通过prepareSharedConnection(Connection)对其进行准备。

items.source: Subclasses may override this method to check against temporary conditions that prevent listeners from actually running. In other words, they may apply further restrictions to the 'running' state, returning false if such a restriction prevents listeners from running.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以检查阻止监听器实际运行的临时条件。换句话说，它们可以对“运行”状态施加进一步的限制，如果此类限制阻止了监听器的运行，则返回`false`。

items.source: To be implemented by subclasses if they ever call rescheduleTaskIfNecessary. This implementation throws an UnsupportedOperationException.
items.translation: 由子类在它们调用 rescheduleTaskIfNecessary 时实现。此实现抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

items.source: A shared JMS Connection, if any, will automatically be closed afterwards.
items.translation: 如果存在共享的 JMS 连接，它将在之后自动关闭。

items.source:
This base class does not assume any specific listener programming model
or listener invoker mechanism. It just provides the general runtime
lifecycle management needed for any kind of JMS-based listening mechanism
that operates on a JMS Connection/Session.
items.translation: 该基类不假定任何特定的监听器编程模型或监听器调用机制。它仅提供任何基于 JMS 的监听机制在 JMS Connection/Session 上运行时所需的一般生命周期管理。

items.source: The default implementation is empty. To be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现为空，应在子类中重写。

items.source:
Called on startup and also after an infrastructure exception
that occurred during invoker setup and/or execution.
items.translation: 在启动时调用，并在 invoker 设置和/或执行期间发生基础设施异常后调用。

items.source:
The default implementation sets the specified client id, if any.
Subclasses can override this to apply further settings.
items.translation: 默认实现会设置指定的客户端 ID（如果有）。子类可以重写此方法以应用进一步的设置。

items.source:
If this container has already been shut down, the task will not
get rescheduled at all.
items.translation: 如果该容器已经停止，任务将不会被重新调度。

items.source:
The default implementation simply logs a corresponding message
at warn level.
items.translation: 默认实现只是在警告级别记录相应的消息。

items.source:
A shared JMS Connection, if any, will already have been
started at this point.
items.translation: 如果存在共享的 JMS 连接，此时它应该已经启动。

items.source: Returns true if this Lifecycle component should get started automatically by the container at the time that the containing ApplicationContext gets refreshed or restarted.
items.translation: 如果此 `Lifecycle` 组件应在包含的 ApplicationContext 刷新或重启时自动启动，则返回 `true`。

items.source: Description copied from interface: SmartLifecycle
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：SmartLifecycle

items.source: Log a task that has been rejected by doRescheduleTask(Object).
items.translation: 记录被doRescheduleTask(Object)拒绝的任务。

items.source: Start the shared Connection, if any, and notify all invoker tasks.
items.translation: 启动共享的连接（如果有），并通知所有调用任务。

items.source: Notify all invoker tasks and stop the shared Connection, if any.
items.translation: 通知所有调用任务，并停止共享的 Connection（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the bean name that this listener container has been assigned
in its containing bean factory, if any.
items.translation: 返回此监听器容器在其包含的 Bean 工厂中分配的 Bean 名称（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the JMS client ID for the shared Connection created and used
by this container, if any.
items.translation: 返回此容器创建并使用的共享连接的 JMS 客户端 ID（如果有）。

items.source: Determine the number of currently paused tasks, if any.
items.translation: 确定当前暂停的任务数量（如果有）。

items.source: Return the lifecycle phase in which this container will be started and stopped.
items.translation: 返回该容器将启动和停止的生命周期阶段。

items.source:
Return whether this container is currently active,
that is, whether it has been set up but not shut down yet.
items.translation: 返回该容器当前是否处于活动状态，即它是否已启动但尚未关闭。

items.source:
Determine whether this container is currently running,
that is, whether it has been started and not stopped yet.
items.translation: 确定该容器当前是否正在运行，即它是否已启动且尚未停止。

items.source: Release the shared Connection, if any.
items.translation: 释放共享的 Connection（如果有）。

items.source:
Return whether a shared JMS Connection should be maintained
by this container base class.
items.translation: 返回此容器基类是否应维护共享的 JMS 连接。

items.source: Start this container.
items.translation: 启动该容器。

items.source: Start the shared Connection.
items.translation: 启动共享连接。

items.source: Stop this container.
items.translation: 停止此容器。

items.source: Stop the shared Connection.
items.translation: 停止共享连接。

items.source:
Return the shared JMS Connection maintained by this container.
Available after initialization.
items.translation: 返回此容器维护的共享 JMS 连接。初始化后可用。

items.source:
Try to resume all paused tasks.
Tasks for which rescheduling failed simply remain in paused mode.
items.translation: 尝试恢复所有已暂停的任务。重新调度失败的任务将保持暂停状态。

(either immediately or for a restart of this container)

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source:
Note that client IDs need to be unique among all active Connections
of the underlying JMS provider. Furthermore, a client ID can only be
assigned if the original ConnectionFactory hasn't already assigned one.
items.translation: 请注意，客户端 ID 必须在底层 JMS 提供程序的所有活动连接中保持唯一。此外，仅当原始的 ConnectionFactory 尚未分配客户端 ID 时，才能分配客户端 ID。

Exception that indicates that the initial setup of this container's
shared JMS Connection failed.
items.translation: 指示此容器的共享 JMS 连接初始设置失败的异常。

items.source: Create a shared Connection for this container.
items.translation: 为此容器创建一个共享的 Connection。

items.source: Register any invokers within this container.
items.translation: 在此容器内注册任何调用器。

items.source: Reschedule the given task object immediately.
items.translation: 立即重新调度给定的任务对象。

items.source: Close the registered invokers.
items.translation: 关闭已注册的调用器。

items.source: Establish a shared Connection for this container.
items.translation: 为此容器建立共享连接。

items.source: Return the shared JMS Connection maintained by this container.
items.translation: 返回此容器维护的共享 JMS 连接。

items.source: Initialize this container.

items.source:
Prepare the given Connection, which is about to be registered
as shared Connection for this container.
items.translation: 准备即将注册为此容器共享连接的给定连接。

items.source: Refresh the shared Connection that this container holds.
items.translation: 刷新该容器持有的共享连接。

items.source:
Take the given task object and reschedule it, either immediately if
this container is currently running, or later once this container
has been restarted.
items.translation: 将给定的任务对象重新调度：如果当前容器正在运行，则立即重新调度；否则，待该容器重启后再进行重新调度。

items.source: Try to resume all paused tasks.
items.translation: 尝试恢复所有已暂停的任务。

items.source: Check whether this container's listeners are generally allowed to run.
items.translation: 检查该容器的监听器是否通常被允许运行。

items.source: Set whether to automatically start the container after initialization.
items.translation: 设置是否在初始化后自动启动容器。

items.source: Set the name of the bean in the bean factory that created this bean.
items.translation: 在创建此 Bean 的 Bean Factory 中设置该 Bean 的名称。

items.source:
Specify the JMS client ID for a shared Connection created and used
by this container.
items.translation: 为此容器创建和使用的共享连接指定 JMS 客户端 ID。

items.source: Specify the lifecycle phase in which this container should be started and stopped.
items.translation: 指定该容器应启动和停止的生命周期阶段。

items.source: Validate the configuration of this container.
items.translation: 验证此容器的配置。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。
